title: add support for interrupt triggered tasks

STRING[n] (limited-length string type) is not parsed
String literal operands of LEN, CONCAT and comparisons are emitted as const char[], which the runtime does not accept
VAR_TEMP variables are emitted as members and keep their value between calls
TOD - TOD (and DT - DT, DATE - DATE) is typed as the operand type, not TIME
a subrange variable is initialised to 0, not to its lower limit
CONTINUE is not parsed
MUX with expression inputs does not compile (template deduction, int vs IEC_INT)
NOT of an AND/OR/XOR of comparisons does not compile
TON, TOF and TP switch one scan after ET reaches PT (is_in_preset_range uses <=)
TP ignores the next rising edge after a pulse that ended with IN already FALSE
SR and RS inputs are named SET1/RESET and SET/RESET1 instead of the standard S1/R and S/R1
LIMIT inputs are named MIN/MAX instead of the standard MN/MX, so LIMIT(MN := ...) does not resolve
EN := and .ENO are not available on a function block invocation (E048)
Untyped real literals assigned to an LREAL are evaluated in REAL: 1.0E15 + 1.0 gives 999999986991104
A subrange variable without an initial value starts at 0 instead of its lower limit
LIMIT with MN > MX returns MN instead of MIN(MAX(IN, MN), MX)
MUX has no overload for unsigned integers, SINT, bit strings or dates (SEL has them)
-16#10 is a syntax error (unary minus before a based literal)
MIN/MAX are not extensible, and the comparison functions GT/GE/EQ/LE/LT/NE are missing
CTU/CTD/CTUD and F_TRIG follow the 2001 FDIS bodies, not ed.3
Integer division by zero with the / operator depends on the CPU: SIGFPE on x86-64, silent 0 on AArch64 (MOD and DIV() are guarded)
Inline function-call wrappers are emitted outside #ifndef __POUS_INIT_ONLY__, so config.c calls an undeclared function (build error with clang >= 16 and gcc >= 14)
The + - * / operators on TIME generate calls to _____time_add etc., which do not exist, so the program does not build
REPLACE(IN1, IN2, L, P) inserts only the first L characters of IN2
A STRING[n] variable is parsed but then reported "not declared in this scope" (stage3 visitors commented out)
Tasks of a resource run in declaration order: PRIORITY is ignored when several tasks are due at the same tick
A duration literal with milliseconds is 1 ns short: T#1h2m3s4ms gives tv_nsec = 3999999
Guard the integer / operator against a zero divisor
functions with VAR_OUTPUT / VAR_IN_OUT are called before their declaration under __POUS_INIT_ONLY__ (clang / gcc 14 error)
LIMIT with MN > MX returns MN instead of MX (MIN(MAX(IN, MN), MX))
__time_mul (TIME * n) overflows a 32-bit int on the nanosecond part: T#700ms * 4 gives T#2147ms
An array element as a function's VAR_OUTPUT or VAR_IN_OUT argument generates invalid C ('table' + subscript without brackets)
NOT on a BYTE or WORD inside a comparison is computed as an int: (NOT b) = c is FALSE for b = 16#00, c = 16#FF
A VAR_IN_OUT / VAR_OUTPUT function call inside another call's argument does not link (its per-call wrapper is not generated, and later wrappers are misnumbered)
DELETE refuses a range that ends at the last character (off-by-one bound check)
func_LIMIT.h uses func_MAX / func_MIN without including them
no func_MUX.h, although the 4diac IDE 3.3.0 exports an include for it
Make func_LIMIT.h include its MIN and MAX dependencies
an input omitted from a formal function call is 0 instead of its declared initial value
ST lexer: T#1.5s is not accepted, and an identifier named t is taken for a T# literal prefix
ST standard functions: LIMIT/SEL formal parameter names, TRUNC, *_TO_STRING
MCP run: implement stimuli (time-ordered input drives)
Whole-element assignment of an array-of-struct element is not implemented
Support more than one PROGRAM in a compiled container
Extensible standard functions (ADD, MUL, AND, OR, XOR) accept only two inputs
REAL_TO_INT truncates instead of rounding
A VAR_TEMP variable of a function block passes check but fails to compile
CTU, CTD and CTUD of INT count past the range of INT, so CV wraps when stored in an INT
TOF starts an off-delay at power-up although IN was never TRUE
TP retriggers while IN stays TRUE, and holds ET = PT after the pulse with IN FALSE

Make MIN and MAX extensible, folding three or more inputs from the left
an input omitted from a formal function call is rejected (P4018) instead of taking its initial value

MIN, MAX and LIMIT reject TIME operands (expected=ANY_NUM) although they are declared on ANY_ELEMENTARY
F_TRIG reports no edge on its first execution with CLK FALSE (ed.3 table 45 gives Q = TRUE)

Take an untyped based literal as a bit string where one goes (G224)
